title: ImpactAnalysis
description: E2E-06 Task 6: explicit statement of how a change request affects existing assets. Produced by code-actuator impact_analysis; the size feeds price-book estimate_rules.

confidence.description: Basis of the claims: 'observed' = direct measurement, 'derived' = computed from observed facts, 'inferred' = model or heuristic judgment.

authority.description: Channel the claims rest on. impact_analysis is always 'analyst-inference': reasoning-backend judgment over an observed inventory.

limitations.description: Coverage limits a consumer must weigh before relying on the result.

unknowns.description: Aspects that remain unresolved rather than absent.
